cohort: 568 women admitted for a trial of labor after cesarean delivery
finding: The Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network prediction model for VBAC success was highly accurate for women with predicted success rates above 65%, but underestimated success rates for women with lower predicted probabilities.
mod_finding: The study focused on predicting successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC), with findings specific to VBAC success rates and not comparing different modes of delivery.
